column2: Working-tree repair against an already-correct index, so no commit exists by design. Check: git -C ../../../LibKa0s ls-files --eol | grep -E "w/(lf|mixed)" lists only the two .sh files under attr eol=lf.

Issue-store reconciliation; its artefacts are GitHub comments, not commits. Check: gh issue view 15 --repo tusharsaxena/LibKa0s shows the M2-23 disposition comment; the issue has since moved to state:done, closed by the v1.26.0 fix and its adoption.
Smoke-only session (the five-addon load-order sweep); its Repo column is an em-dash and it produces no commit by design. Check: grep -n "M4-03" 04_EXECUTION_PLAN.md shows the Repo column as "—".

Issue-store filing; its artefacts are 25 GitHub issues across eight repositories, not commits — no repository byte changes, exactly as M2-23. Check: gh issue view 26 --repo tusharsaxena/LibKa0s is the release decline (state:will-not-do) and gh issue view 48 --repo tusharsaxena/PanelMaster is PANELMASTER-A-03 (state:untriaged).
